title: Rattan and woven finds for a boho condo
dek: Six natural-fibre pieces, many from Filipino makers, that bring the relaxed boho look into a small condo: a rattan sunburst mirror, woven baskets, kaing planters, a seagrass tray, an acacia bowl and rattan coasters.
teaser: Six natural-fibre finds from rattan to kaing baskets for a relaxed boho condo.
description: Boho decor for small Filipino condos in real natural materials: a rattan sunburst mirror, seagrass storage baskets, bamboo kaing planters, a woven tray, an acacia bowl and rattan coasters.

hero.alt: AI sample render of a sunlit boho condo corner with a rattan sunburst mirror, seagrass baskets, bamboo kaing planters, a woven tray, an acacia bowl and rattan coasters
hero.caption: AI sample render of our six picks in one room, drawn from written descriptions of each product. The real product photos from Lazada are below.

intro: Boho is the most forgiving style for a small home. It welcomes plants, texture and a little personality, and it ages well because natural fibres only look better with use.

Our country is also one of the best places in the world to shop it: rattan, abaca, buri and bamboo are woven here every day. So every piece below is a real natural material, and we favoured Filipino makers wherever we found them.

curation.title: Curated, not cluttered
summary: Homes & Gardens, House Beautiful and Livingetc agree that boho is relaxed and personality-led, built on natural fibres (rattan, wicker, jute, raffia, wood), plants and an earthy base with bolder accents, and that it should feel curated rather than cluttered. We applied that to a small Filipino condo: one woven statement on the wall, hard-working storage, then smaller repeated textures, using only real natural materials and favouring Filipino makers wherever the affiliate feed allowed.
steps: Read three design guides on boho style and noted what they agree on: natural fibres, plants, an earthy base and a few bold accents.
Planned a small-condo version: one statement piece on the wall, storage that works, then smaller repeated textures.
Compared 2 to 4 Lazada listings per slot, keeping only real natural materials (no plastic "rattan").
Favoured named Filipino makers and checked every product photo against its listing.

House Beautiful: 20 Boho Room Decor Ideas That Bring Good Vibes Into Your Home

tipGroups.title: Three rules for boho in a small space

tips.title: Start with one statement
tips.body: Start with one statement piece, like a rattan mirror on the main wall, then add texture in smaller doses. Livingetc's boho guide stresses curated over cluttered.

tips.title: Neutral base, bold accents
tips.body: Keep walls and big furniture in earthy neutrals and let a banig, a cushion or a plant carry the bold colour, as Homes & Gardens suggests for boho palettes.

tips.title: Give woven pieces air
tips.body: Humidity care: give woven pieces air. Keep them off damp floors and away from aircon drips, wipe with a dry or barely damp cloth (Bria Homes says never rinse rattan), dry in shade, and never store abaca or raffia sealed in plastic, where mould can form.

items.label: Best statement piece
items.name: Ilokana Handicrafts 25-inch rattan sunburst mirror
items.verdict: A rattan sunburst from a Pangasinan maker gives a plain condo wall a real focal point and bounces light around a small sala.
items.summary: Rattan-framed mirrors are a boho staple: House Beautiful shows a cluster of them hung in place of art. This 25-inch sunburst rings a round mirror with radiating rattan rods, so it reads as decor first and a mirror second.

reviewers.point: Ilokana Handicraft of San Manuel was among the Pangasinan small businesses showcased at the Manila FAME trade fair in October 2025.
reviewers.source: Province of Pangasinan: Pangasinan MSMEs' Finest Crafts Shine at Manila FAME 2025 (17 October 2025)

reviewers.point: House Beautiful's boho ideas include hanging an assortment of mirrors with rattan details above a headboard instead of artwork.
Common-sense care: dust the rods with a soft, dry brush, and spray glass cleaner onto a cloth rather than near the rattan.

pros: 25-inch size makes a true focal point
Mirror bounces light in a small condo
cons: Limited stock at our last check, so order early
Hang it on a sturdy hook with room around it
items.bestFor: A bare wall above the sofa, console or bed
items.tip: Hang it where it can catch a window or a lamp. In a small condo, that bounce of light does more for the room than another framed print.

items.label: Best woven storage
items.name: MiraHome square woven storage basket with rattan rim
items.verdict: Square, chunky-weave baskets with rattan rims and cut-out handles hide clutter and still look like decor in a condo sala.
items.summary: Boho rooms run on texture, and baskets add it while solving storage. These square baskets have a chunky twisted weave, smooth rattan rims and cut-out handles, so they slide beside the sofa or under a console for throws, toys or magazines.

reviewers.point: Rattan comes from climbing palms native to tropical Asia and Africa and is widely used for baskets and furniture.
Bria Homes advises never rinsing natural rattan under running water: wipe it clean, then dry it with a microfiber cloth.
reviewers.source: Bria Homes: Ways To Take Care Of Your Rattan Furniture At Home

reviewers.point: Common-sense care: leave a small gap between the basket and the wall so air can circulate in our humidity.

pros: Cut-out handles make them easy to pull out
Square shape fits shelves and corners neatly
Chunky weave adds texture without colour noise
cons: Check which size the ₱400 price covers
Check the measurements in the listing photos
items.bestFor: Throws, magazines, toys or laundry-day overflow
items.tip: Lay a cotton cloth in the bottom for small items. It keeps bits from slipping through the weave and is easy to wash.

alt.name: Ilokana Handicrafts buri hamper with cloth lining
alt.label: Lidded option
alt.note: Want a lid and a lining? This buri hamper from the same Pangasinan maker as our mirror hides laundry neatly, at a higher price.

items.label: Best planter cover
items.name: Eugene's bamboo kaing baskets (set of 3)
items.verdict: The humble bamboo kaing becomes a boho cachepot: slip a potted snake plant inside for instant texture and a very Pinoy story.
items.summary: Plants are a boho must, and the planter matters as much as the plant. Kaing are the bamboo baskets farmers use to carry crops, so they bring honest Filipino craft into a condo. Per the listing name you get three, enough for a small plant corner.

reviewers.point: VERA Files describes kaing as baskets that serve as containers of crops, carried from fields to homes and markets.
reviewers.source: VERA Files: Philippine basketry, a life in leaves and vines (R.C. Ladrido, 26 September 2021)

reviewers.point: The same article notes that bamboo and rattan are the most commonly used materials for Philippine baskets.
Common-sense care: keep the plant in its plastic nursery pot with a saucer inside, so water never soaks the bamboo.

pros: Locally made, per the listing photo
Three pieces for a plant trio or storage
cons: Check the sizes against your plant pots
Line the open weave for small items
items.bestFor: Snake plants, ZZ plants or pothos in a bright corner
items.tip: Water the plant in the sink and let it drain before it goes back in the basket. Bamboo that stays dry lasts far longer.

items.label: Best everyday tray
items.name: Rattan and abaka rectangular tray basket with handles
items.verdict: A shallow rattan-and-abaca basket with handles corrals remotes on the coffee table or carries merienda from kitchen to sala.
items.summary: This shallow rectangle pairs a twisted abaca-look weave with a rattan rim and looped handles, so it works as a coffee-table tray, a bread basket or a catch-all by the door. It is also popular with recent buyers.

reviewers.point: Homes & Gardens quotes designer Dara Segbefia adding 'natural materials like wood, rattan, and jute' to get the boho look.
Bria Homes advises keeping rattan out of direct sunlight and drying it with a clean microfiber cloth after cleaning.
reviewers.source: Bria Homes: Ways To Take Care Of Your Rattan Furniture At Home

pros: Handles make it easy to carry
Doubles as tray, bread basket or catch-all
cons: Add a mat under drinks; the base is open
Check the size against your table
items.bestFor: Remotes on the coffee table, or pandesal on the dining table
items.tip: Line it with a cotton napkin when serving bread or pandesal. It keeps crumbs out of the weave and goes straight into the wash.

alt.name: Basket Trend oval rattan tray with faux-leather handles
alt.label: From a Rizal basket maker
alt.note: Basket Trend is a family-run maker in Taytay, Rizal, founded in 1986, per its About page (https://www.basket-trend.com/about). Its oval rattan tray measures 13.5 x 10.25 x 3 inches per the listing photo and has tan faux-leather handles.

items.label: Best wood accent
items.name: Woodywood acacia wood bowl (9 x 3 in)
items.verdict: A deep acacia bowl balances all the weave with smooth, warm wood, and keeps mangoes or bananas on show on the table.
items.summary: Boho mixes textures, and a little smooth wood keeps a room full of baskets from feeling busy. This 9-inch acacia bowl has a rich striped grain and is deep enough for fruit, salad or chips for the barkada. It makes a good housewarming gift too.

reviewers.point: Homes & Gardens names wood alongside rattan and jute as natural materials that bring an organic, grounding element to a boho room.
Livingetc's boho guide favours curated over cluttered; designer Hubert Zandberg aims for 'a calm conversation between the objects'.
Common-sense care: hand-wash, dry right away and rub in a little food-safe oil now and then. Don't soak it.

pros: Smooth wood contrasts nicely with the weaves
Deep enough for fruit, salad or snacks
cons: Natural grain, so each bowl is one of a kind
items.bestFor: Fruit on the dining table or snacks for guests
items.tip: Keep it out of strong afternoon sun. A shaded spot keeps acacia from drying out and the grain looking rich.

items.label: Best small add-on
items.name: DewyBabe handwoven rattan coaster and trivet mats
items.verdict: Round woven rattan mats are a tiny buy that carries the look onto the table, and they protect wood from hot mugs and pots.
items.summary: Small, repeated textures tie a boho room together. These coiled rattan mats come in several sizes in the listing photo, from mug coaster to pot trivet, and their honey tone matches the mirror and tray. A low-cost way to finish the corner.

reviewers.point: Rattan stems can be split into strips for weaving, and rattan is widely used for handicrafts such as baskets.
Bria Homes advises keeping rattan out of direct sunlight and drying it with a microfiber cloth after cleaning.
reviewers.source: Bria Homes: Ways To Take Care Of Your Rattan Furniture At Home

reviewers.point: Common-sense care: wipe spills right away and let the mats dry flat before stacking them.

pros: Real rattan weave in a warm honey tone
Several sizes, from coaster to trivet
Protects wood tables from hot mugs and pots
cons: An imported design rather than a local maker
₱52 is likely the smallest size; check the set options
items.bestFor: Coffee mugs, teapots and the dining table
items.tip: Use one large mat under a teapot or plant and small ones under mugs. Repeating the same weave makes the corner look planned.
